title: Sign up with valid details
description: Register a brand-new account from the signup page
preconditions: No account exists for the email
steps: Open /signup :: Signup form is shown|Enter name
expected_result: a unique email
priority: and a strong password|Accept Terms of Service and Privacy Policy|Click Sign up
type: Account is created and a verification email is sent; user is told to verify

title: Signup rejects weak password
steps: Enter a valid name and email|Type a weak password (e.g. 123)|Observe the strength meter and submit
expected_result: Submit is blocked or rejected and a weak-password message is shown

title: Signup rejects duplicate email
description: Cannot register an email that already exists
preconditions: An account already exists for the email
steps: Open /signup|Enter the existing email with valid name/password|Submit
expected_result: An "Email is already registered" message is shown

title: Verify email via link
preconditions: A freshly signed-up unverified account exists
steps: Open the verification link from the email|Wait for the page to process
expected_result: Email is marked verified and the user can log in

title: Login with unverified account redirects to verify
description: Unverified users are sent to the verify page
steps: Open /login|Enter the unverified account credentials|Click Log In
expected_result: User is redirected to the email-verification page instead of the dashboard

title: Valid login redirects to dashboard
description: A verified user can log in
steps: Open /login :: Login form is shown|Enter a valid email and password|Click Log In :: Redirected
expected_result: User lands on /dashboard

title: Login fails with wrong password
steps: Open /login|Enter a valid email and a wrong password|Click Log In
expected_result: An invalid-credentials error is shown and the user stays on /login

title: Remember me extends the session
steps: Check "Remember me (30 days)"|Log in with valid credentials
expected_result: Session cookie is set with a 30-day lifetime

title: Forgot password sends reset link
steps: Open the Forgot Password page|Enter the account email|Submit
expected_result: A generic "if the email exists
priority: a reset link was sent" message is shown

title: Reset password with valid token
description: Set a new password from the reset link
preconditions: A valid reset link was issued
steps: Open the reset link|Enter a new strong password and confirm|Submit
expected_result: Password is reset and the user can log in with the new password

title: Reset link is single-use and expiring
description: Expired or used reset tokens are rejected
preconditions: A reset link older than 1 hour or already used
steps: Open the stale reset link
expected_result: An "invalid or expired" message is shown

title: Language switcher toggles EN/ID
steps: Locate the language control|Click ID then EN
expected_result: An EN/ID switcher is visible and switches the page language

title: OAuth login with Google
steps: Open /login|Click Continue with Google|Complete the Google consent
expected_result: User is signed in and (first time) routed to onboarding

title: Set password for OAuth account
description: OAuth-only users can add a password
preconditions: Logged in via OAuth with no password set
steps: Open Settings -> Account|Use the Set password form|Submit a strong password
expected_result: Password is set and the account can also log in via email

title: Change password succeeds
description: An email/password user can change their password
preconditions: Logged in with an email/password account
steps: Open Settings -> Account|Enter current password
expected_result: new password
type: A "Password changed successfully." message is shown

title: Onboarding can be skipped
preconditions: A newly verified account that has not onboarded
steps: Land on /onboarding after first login|Skip each step
expected_result: Onboarding completes and the user reaches the dashboard

title: Onboarding is guarded after completion
preconditions: An account that has already onboarded
steps: Navigate to /onboarding directly
expected_result: User is redirected to /dashboard

title: Dashboard renders in English
description: The app UI defaults to English
steps: Open /dashboard
expected_result: Sidebar (Projects
type: Account) and stat labels render in English

title: Create a project
description: A new project can be created
steps: Open /projects|Fill the new project name|Submit
expected_result: The project is created with the creator as OWNER and appears in the list

title: Archive and reactivate a project
description: Projects can be archived and restored
steps: Open /projects|Click Archive on a project|Click Activate
expected_result: Project status toggles between Active and Archived

title: Sidebar lists projects for one-click nav
description: Active projects appear in the sidebar
preconditions: At least one active project exists
steps: Open any page|Look at the sidebar under Projects
expected_result: Active projects are listed and clicking one opens it directly

title: Invite a team member
description: Org admins can invite by email
preconditions: Logged in as an org ADMIN
steps: Open Settings -> Team|Enter an email and role|Send invitation
expected_result: An invitation is created and an email (or dev link) is produced

title: Change a member role
preconditions: Another member exists in the org
steps: Open Settings -> Team|Change a member's role via the dropdown
expected_result: The member's role updates and is persisted

title: Cannot demote the last admin
description: The org must keep at least one admin
preconditions: Only one ADMIN in the org
steps: Open Settings -> Team|Try to demote the sole admin
expected_result: The action is blocked with a "last admin" message

title: Resend and revoke an invitation
steps: Open Settings -> Team|Click Resend then Revoke on the invite
expected_result: Resend regenerates the link; Revoke removes the invitation

title: Add a member to a project
preconditions: A project and another org member exist
steps: Open the project Members tab|Pick a person and role|Add member
expected_result: The user becomes a ProjectMember and can see the project

title: Change and remove a project member
preconditions: A project has more than one member
steps: Open Members tab|Change a member role|Remove a member
expected_result: Role updates persist; removed member loses project access

title: Create a test suite
preconditions: Inside a project as a non-viewer
steps: Open the project|Enter a suite name in the sidebar|Click Add Suite
expected_result: The suite appears in the tree and the input clears

title: Delete an empty suite
preconditions: A suite with no test cases exists
steps: Open the project|Click the delete control on the empty suite|Confirm
expected_result: The suite (and its empty sub-suites) is removed

title: Cannot delete a suite with cases
preconditions: A suite containing at least one case
steps: Click the delete control on the non-empty suite
expected_result: A warning is shown and the suite is not deleted

title: Create a test case
preconditions: Inside a project as a non-viewer
steps: Open + Test Case|Fill title
expected_result: steps
tags: The case is created with an auto ID TC-<SLUG>-<n>

title: New case defaults to the open suite
description: Creating from a suite preselects it
preconditions: Viewing the cases list filtered by a suite
steps: Click + Test Case|Observe the Test Suite dropdown
expected_result: The dropdown defaults to the selected suite and stays editable

title: Edit a test case
steps: Open a case|Click Edit|Change fields and save
expected_result: The changes are persisted and shown on the detail page

title: Clone a test case
steps: Open a case|Click Clone
expected_result: A copy is created with a new ID

title: Delete a test case with confirmation
steps: Open a case|Click Delete|Confirm in the dialog
expected_result: The case is soft-deleted and removed from the list

title: Back button returns to the cases list
steps: Click "Back to test cases"
expected_result: User returns to the cases list scoped to the case's suite

title: Filter and search test cases
steps: Open the cases list|Use the search box
expected_result: priority

title: Bulk edit test cases
description: Change fields on many cases at once
steps: Select multiple cases|Choose a field and value in the bulk bar|Apply
expected_result: The selected cases are updated

title: Select all with Ctrl/Cmd+A
steps: Press Ctrl/Cmd+A|Press Escape
expected_result: Ctrl/Cmd+A selects every row; Escape clears the selection

title: Bulk delete with project-name confirmation
steps: Click Delete (n)|Type the exact project name|Confirm
expected_result: Selected cases are soft-deleted; deletes are blocked until the name matches

title: Import cases from CSV into a suite
description: CSV import with a target suite
preconditions: A project and a CSV file exist
steps: Open Import|Choose a target suite|Preview & Validate|Import valid rows
expected_result: Cases are created and assigned to the chosen suite

title: Export cases to CSV
steps: Open the cases list|Click Export CSV
expected_result: A CSV of the project's cases is downloaded

title: Create a manual test run
steps: Open Test Runs|Click New Test Run|Select cases and create
expected_result: A run is created with the chosen cases as untested

title: Execute a run with P/F/B shortcuts
steps: Open the run|Use P/F/B keyboard shortcuts on cases
expected_result: Each case status updates and progress advances

title: Upload JUnit results via API
preconditions: A valid API key and matching cases exist
steps: POST a JUnit XML to /api/v1/junit with project and source|Check Test Runs
expected_result: A run is created and tests are matched to cases by TC-ID or title

title: Run shows its origin
description: Reports show where a run came from
steps: Open Reports or Test Runs
expected_result: The run displays an origin badge (e.g. CI - GitHub Actions or Local)

title: Reports show pass rate and flaky tests
steps: Open Reports
expected_result: Pass rate

title: Create an API key and copy it
steps: Open Settings -> API Keys|Create a key|Click Copy
expected_result: The key is shown once with a working Copy button

title: Delete an API key with confirmation
steps: Open Settings -> API Keys|Click Delete|Confirm
expected_result: The key is revoked after confirmation

title: Audit log is scoped to the organization
steps: Open Settings -> Audit Log|Click Download CSV
expected_result: Only the org's entries are listed and a CSV can be downloaded

title: Project access is isolated per tenant
steps: Log in as a user from org A|Try to open a project URL from org B
expected_result: Access is denied (404) for non-members

title: Logout ends the session
steps: Click Log out|Try to open a protected page
expected_result: User is signed out and redirected to login
